jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Analyst – Fixed Income Investments Technology
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident. 

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.  

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you. 

Role Summary

Help shape the next generation of portfolio management technology at T. Rowe Price.

The Fixed Income Investments Technology team at T. Rowe Price is seeking an experienced Senior Analyst to partner with business and engineering teams in building the next generation of cloud-first portfolio management capabilities.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong business analysis and domain expertise with a technology-forward mindset. You will serve as a key partner to both engineering and business stakeholders, helping translate investment needs into scalable solutions across the Fixed Income organization. A major focus of the role will be supporting Portfolio Management workflows and related capabilities that directly impact front-office investment teams.

This is more than a traditional business analyst role. We are looking for someone who can blend subject matter expertise, product thinking, analytical rigor, and an engineering mindset to help deliver high-quality tools for investment professionals.

Why this Role Is Exciting:

You will work closely with front-office technology teams and investment professionals to deliver software products that support critical decision-making across fixed income investing. In this role, you will:

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across fixed income asset classes
  • Partner with engineers to define complex business logic and domain-specific calculations
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, data quality, and investment outcomes through technology
  • Contribute to a broader technology and data transformation underway across the firm

At T. Rowe Price, we are making significant investments in the future of our technology and data platforms. We have ambitious goals and a clear vision for where we are headed. Collaboration is central to how we work, and we value curious, thoughtful, team-oriented individuals who enjoy learning, solving problems, and working across disciplines. You’ll join a team of diverse thinkers who bring different perspectives together to build impactful solutions for the business.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers, Quants, and Investment Analysts across global teams
  • Partner with stakeholders and engineering teams to define, develop, and deliver the business cases and roadmaps for Fixed Income portfolio management
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and prioritized backlog items
  • Communicate priorities, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to both business and technology stakeholders
  • Work closely with agile technology teams to implement business requirements, process improvements, and automation opportunities
  • Analyze portfolio management workflows and propose innovative technology solutions that improve efficiency and business outcomes
  • Identify data quality and integrity issues, perform in-depth analysis, and recommend solutions
  • Independently troubleshoot functional and quantitative issues related to portfolio analytics and investment workflows
  • Support the development of prototype logic and analytical approaches that help define complex business rules and calculation methodologies

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an analyst, business analyst, product analyst, or similar role
  • Strong ability to work across both business and technology teams
  • Experience gathering requirements, prioritizing work, and supporting delivery in a collaborative environment
  • Ability to independently analyze and troubleshoot functional and/or quantitative issues in portfolio analytics or related investment workflows
  • Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills

Preferred:

  • Experience working with Portfolio Managers and Trading teams
  • Experience with portfolio management and trading platforms
  • Systems analysis experience or experience analyzing data for front-office investment functions
  • General knowledge of macroeconomic and financial markets, particularly within the asset management industry
  • Strong data analysis skills, including:
    • SQL queries
    • Excel / Access data manipulation
    • Jupyter notebooks

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

What Makes This Role Different

This position represents an evolution of the traditional business analyst role. It is designed for someone who can operate at the intersection of investments, technology, product, and data—bringing both domain expertise and an engineering-oriented approach to solving complex front-office challenges.

If you are energized by the opportunity to work closely with investment teams, influence product direction, and help modernize critical portfolio management capabilities, we’d love to hear from you.

At T. Rowe Price, we are making significant investments in the future of our technology and data platforms. We have ambitious goals and a clear vision for where we are headed. Collaboration is central to how we work, and we value curious, thoughtful, team-oriented individuals who enjoy learning, solving problems, and working across disciplines. You’ll join a team of diverse thinkers who bring different perspectives together to build impactful solutions for the business.

Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (e.g., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant work status). 


WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING

1. You will receive an email and text message to answer a few questions to verify your eligibility. If you apply for multiple jobs, you will receive separate invitations for each role and will need to respond to each. Estimated Time Commitment: 3-5 minutes

2. If you are eligible, you will be asked to record video responses to introductory questions with our vendor partner, HireVue. Take time to read all instructions carefully before responding. Some questions may require you to respond within a set time limit, or with limited retakes. You can use this opportunity to tell us more about your background and interest than we can learn from a resume alone. Estimated Time Commitment: 20-30 minutes

Base Salary Ranges

Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity.

$96,500.00 - $164,000.00 for the location of: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers
$105,000.00 - $180,000.00 for the location of: Washington, D.C.
$120,000.00 - $205,000.00 for the location of: New York, California

Placement within the range provided above is based on the individual’s relevant experience and skills for the role.  Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package.  Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon company and individual performance.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At T. Rowe Price, our associates are our greatest asset. We thrive because our company culture is built on inclusion and because we sustain a work environment where associates can bring their best selves to work every day. The backgrounds, talents, and experiences of our global associates allow us to embrace new ideas and perspectives that move our business priorities forward and enable us to deliver strong client outcomes. Here, you can expect equal opportunity and fair and consistent treatment for all. 

Benefits

We value your goals and needs, at work and in life. As an associate, you’ll be supported with resources, benefits, and work-life balance so you can thrive in ways that matter to you.   

  

Featured employee benefits to enrich your life:   

  • Competitive compensation  

  • Annual bonus eligibility  

  • A generous retirement plan  

  • Hybrid work schedule  

  • Health and wellness benefits, including online therapy  

  • Paid time off for vacation, illness, medical appointments, and volunteering days  

  • Family care resources, including fertility and adoption benefits  

  

Learn more about our benefits.  

T. Rowe Price is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity of thought, gender, and race. We believe our continued success depends upon the equal treatment of all associates and applicants for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, or any other classification protected by country, federal, state, or local law.
